name: mkpsxiso
notes: Prebuilt binaries mkpsxiso and dumpsxiso from the upstream GitHub release v2.30 (asset mkpsxiso-2.30-Darwin.zip, a universal x86_64+arm64 build; sha256 is of that zip). The earlier CMake build is kept aside in bin.local-build/. test.sh builds a small ISO from a tiny XML/file set with mkpsxiso and reads it back with dumpsxiso. Passed on 2026-10-16 with these binaries.
